def get_screen_raw(tz):
    cmd = ["tmux", "new-session", "-d", "-s", "digextr", "-x", "80", "-y", "24", "-e", f"TZ={tz}", "./executable", "-s", "-f", "%H%M%S"]
    subprocess.run(cmd)
    time.sleep(0.15)
    res = subprocess.run(["tmux", "capture-pane", "-e", "-t", "digextr", "-p"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    res_p = subprocess.run(["tmux", "capture-pane", "-t", "digextr", "-p"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    subprocess.run(["tmux", "kill-session", "-t", "digextr"])
    
    plain = res_p.stdout.decode()
    time_str = None
    for l in plain.splitlines():
        if len(l.strip()) == 6 and l.strip().isdigit():
            time_str = l.strip()
            break
            
    raw = res.stdout.decode()
    clock_lines = [l for l in raw.splitlines() if "\x1b[42m" in l or "\x1b[49m" in l]
    return time_str, clock_lines

# For each line in clock_lines, parse the color blocks
# A digit is 3 cells wide. Each cell is 2 terminal columns ("  ").
# In non-centered default mode (x=1):
# Digit 0 (H1): x = 1 (cols 1..6)
# Digit 1 (H2): x = 8 (cols 8..13)
# Colon 1: x = 15 (cols 15..16)
# Digit 2 (M1): x = 18 (cols 18..23)

            time_str = l.strip()
            break

    clock_lines = [l for l in raw.splitlines() if "\x1b[42m" in l or "\x1b[49m" in l]
    return time_str, clock_lines

    tz = f"UTC{-h}"
    t_str, lines = get_screen_raw(tz)
    if not t_str or len(lines) != 5:
        continue
        
    # We use positions: [5, 13, 22, 28, 37, 44]
    positions = [5, 13, 22, 28, 37, 44]
    for idx, x_start in enumerate(positions):
        d_char = t_str[idx]
        if d_char not in digits:

                line = lines[r]
                row_cells = []
                for cell_idx in range(3):

                    curr_col = 0

                    while i < len(line):

                            curr_bg = True
                            i += 5
                        elif line[i:i+5] == "\x1b[49m":
                            curr_bg = False
                            i += 5
                        elif line[i] == "\x1b":
                            m = re.match(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]|\x0e|\x0f", line[i:])
